source_text: Etsi plurimos gentilium scio, Vigili sanctissime, ab ordine atque ratione ueritatis auersos, quominus Dominum noscant, caecitate mentis errare, tamen magis Iudaicae plebis insaniam noui aduersus nomen Domini pertinaci etiam nunc duritia cordis ingenita patrum iniquitate perstare, auersantes ueram salutem nec inquirentes aeternae uitae datorem, ut qui delictis stirpis antiquae sint pari merito nequitiae genitalis obnoxii, saltim uel sero credentes possint conuerso ad Deum timore satisfactione omni paenitentiae ab iniquitatibus liberari. sed perstat et durat adhuc et semper puto durabit ad deque progeniem succidaneam innata patrum inreligiosa perfidia, quae aduersus odium nominis Domini incredulitatis insania roborata nec ad noscendam ueritatem potest corrigi nec ad timorem Dei ipsius monitis doceri atque suaderi. cum autem doceat Dominus et ostendat dicens: ego sum lumen saeculi: et qui me secutus fuerit non ambulabit in tenebris, sed habebit lumen uitae, quam malum ratio est ostensum diuinitus uitae lumen omittere et mentis caecitatem malle, tenebras mortis eligere, ut ostendant damnationis suae propriae uoluntatis libera et licita perditione contra Deum etiam illa nolle quae prosunt ? secundum quod et per Domini uocem increpatam Hierusalem, quod colligi noluerit Deo illam uolente colligere, loquitur spiritus sanctus et bonitatem Dei manifestat peccatoribus subuenire iugiter uelle: Hierusalem Hierusalem, quae interficis prophetas et lapidas eos qui ad te missi sunt, quotiens uolui colligere filios tuos, sicut gallina colligit filios suos sub ascellas suas, et noluisti? adeo Dei uoce manifeste perfidi populi contumacia denotatur, ut etiam salutem propriam suam semper aduersus clementem misericordiam Domini spreuisse doceatur. propheta item alius beniuolentiam Dei exhortatione praedicationis offerens et insinuans proclamat et suadet dicens: reuertimini ad me, et ego reuertar ad nos, dicit Dominus. alius uero similiter: misericordiam suam Deus sempiternam manere demonstrans addidit dicens: nolo mortem morientis, quantum ut reuertatur et uiuat, dicit Dominus.
thought_title: Jewish unbelief persists despite God's repeated calls
orientation: The author opens his letter to Bishop Vigilius by contrasting Gentile blindness with the more culpable, inherited unbelief of the Jewish people, whom God has repeatedly called to return.
pass_a_gloss: Although I know that very many of the Gentiles, most holy Vigilius, turned away from the order and reason of truth, so that they do not know the Lord, wander in blindness of mind, nevertheless I know that the madness of the Jewish people persists against the name of the Lord even now with stubborn hardness of heart and with the inborn wickedness of their fathers, rejecting true salvation and not seeking the giver of eternal life, so that those who are liable for the sins of the ancient stock with equal desert of inborn wickedness might at least, even believing late, with fear turned to God, be freed from their iniquities by every satisfaction of repentance. But it persists and endures still and always, I think, will endure to the successive offspring, the inborn irreligious faithlessness of the fathers, which, strengthened against hatred of the name of the Lord by the madness of unbelief, can neither be corrected to know the truth nor be taught and persuaded to the fear of God by his own warnings. But when the Lord teaches and shows, saying: I am the light of the world: and he who has followed me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life, how evil a reason it is to omit the light of life shown by divinity and to prefer the blindness of mind, to choose the darkness of death, so that they show by the free and permitted destruction of their own will against God that they do not want even those things which are beneficial for their own condemnation? According to which also through the voice of the Lord Jerusalem was reproached, because she did not want to be gathered when God wanted to gather her, the Holy Spirit speaks and shows the goodness of God to want to help sinners continually: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to you, how often did I want to gather your children, as a hen gathers her children under her wings, and you did not want it? So by the voice of God the stubbornness of the faithless people is clearly marked, so that it is taught that they have always spurned their own salvation against the merciful compassion of the Lord. Another prophet likewise, offering and introducing the benevolence of God by the exhortation of preaching, proclaims and persuades, saying: Return to me, and I will return to you, says the Lord. Another likewise, showing that the mercy of God remains everlasting, added, saying: I do not want the death of the dying, so much as that he should turn back and live, says the Lord.

choices.why: Keeps the glossary term 'unbelief' for incredulitas and preserves the strong noun insania as 'madness' to match the author's polemical tone.
Uses the fixed glossary rendering for duritia cordis.
Uses the fixed glossary rendering for perfidia, which the brief bans as 'perfidy' or 'treachery'.
Keeps the glossary term 'light' for lumen and renders the genitive literally as 'of life' to preserve the biblical echo.
Uses the fixed glossary rendering 'salvation' for salus and keeps the emphatic double possessive 'their own' to match the source's redundancy.
Renders clementem as 'merciful' and misericordiam as 'compassion' to distinguish the two Latin terms while keeping the sense of God's gentle mercy.

pass_b_english: I know, most holy Vigilius, that many among the Gentiles have turned away from the order and reason of truth, and so wander in blindness of mind and fail to know the Lord. Yet I know that the madness of the Jewish people persists even now against the name of the Lord with a stubborn hardness of heart inherited from the wickedness of their ancestors. They reject true salvation and do not seek the giver of eternal life. Since they are liable for the sins of their ancient stock by an equal merit of inborn wickedness, they could at least believe late, turn to God in fear, and be freed from their iniquities by full repentance. But their inherited irreligious faithlessness persists and endures even now, and I think it will always endure down to their successive offspring. Strengthened by the madness of unbelief against hatred of the Lord's name, they cannot be corrected to know the truth, nor can they be taught and persuaded by his own warnings to fear God.

The Lord teaches and shows this when he says, "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life" (John 8:12). How evil a choice it is to abandon the light of life shown by God and prefer the blindness of the mind, to choose the darkness of death, so that by the free and permitted destruction of their own will they show against God that they refuse even the things that benefit them!

The Holy Spirit speaks in the same way through the Lord's voice when Jerusalem is reproached because she refused to be gathered, though God willed to gather her. He makes known God's goodness, that he always wishes to come to the aid of sinners: "Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I wanted to gather your children, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you refused!" (Matthew 23:37). So clearly is the stubbornness of the faithless people marked out by God's own voice that they are shown to have always despised their own salvation against the merciful compassion of the Lord.

Another prophet likewise offers and presents God's goodwill with the urging of his preaching, proclaiming and persuading: "Return to me, and I will return to you, says the Lord" (Malachi 3:7). Another similarly, showing that God's mercy endures forever, added: "I do not want the death of the dying, but that he turn back and live, says the Lord" (Ezekiel 33:11).

last_rejected.quote: against hatred of the Lord's name
last_rejected.why: Source means 'against the hatred of the Lord's name' (i.e., against the hatred directed at the name), not 'against hatred of the name'.
last_rejected.fix: against the hatred of the Lord's name
last_rejected.ruling: Latin 'aduersus odium nominis Domini' = 'against hatred of the Lord's name', translation matches.
